top.line: The partner programme as built on agenticcells.ai overnight, from two newsroom articles.
top.para: Pages, figures, price, terms, designs, languages.

in-short.line: Live; a tagline; one page per partner; four figures; £250 and free evaluations; terms; ten languages.

night.line: From article to site in a night: the newsroom thinks in public, the site's team implements.

tagline.line: "Partners: you bring the business, we build the site" is the whole programme.

pages.line: Freelancer, consultancy and firm pages, each standing alone, each with a worked example.

figures.line: The fit, the flow, who does what and the money, drawn by the designer agent.

price.line: £250 launch price against £500, and a limited number of free evaluation sites each day.

terms.line: Partner terms published as terms: 50/50, whoever has the customer invoices, customer owns the site.

designs.line: Five designs on every page and ten languages from day one.

now.line: This week the links go to freelancers and companies; the first shape the terms.

limits.line: Nothing sold, no partner signed; translations unreviewed; examples are examples.

sources.line: agenticcells.ai and its repository's board, 17 and 18 November 2026.
